Q1: Should this issue produce a code change, and if so, how much should the actionlint download retries be hardened?
Context: The failure was a GitHub-side 504 lasting about 7 seconds of retries (backoff of 1s, 2s and 4s), and it has now happened twice. Every option below keeps the pinned version, the `ACTIONLINT_SHA256` check, `-sSLf`, `--connect-timeout 20` and `--max-time 120`. The contract test allows at most `--retry 5`, so going above 5 would also mean changing that test.
Choices:
- A: Make no code change. Re-run CI runs 42465389350 and 42465385872 and close this issue as a transient outage.
- B: Harden the retries within the current test limit: change the actionlint `curl` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` to `--retry 5 --retry-delay 5`, which waits about 25 seconds in total. Update the step comment to cite CI run 42465389350, and keep `tests/test_ci_actionlint_install_retry.py` passing, adding an assertion for the new delay if useful. (RECOMMENDED)
- C: Harden further: keep `--retry 5` but add `--retry-max-time 300` with a longer fixed `--retry-delay` (for example 15), so the download can wait out an outage of a few minutes. Update the comment and the contract test the same way as in B.
